dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: Uh, what's the next step again?

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: I—I'm trying to think about how to make one of the dishes on the menu. I... I was just an apprentice before this, but my old mentor has had to take time off recently due to back pain...

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: I might have to take on the main entree soon enough, so I've got to visualize every detail of this dish. Won't do to start scrambling only after I start work...

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: W—We're holding... Things are a bit busy, but that's par for the course. Our boss is a good fellow. Never made us work harder just to scrounge up a few more Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: A while back, we had customers saying, "Why don't you do take-out, huh? That's how they do it over in Mondstadt!"

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: Why, even my tail would've been up in arms if we had to do that, but fortunately, the boss rejected that request, saying, "If you really want to try our food, come here and have it piping-hot!"

dialogues.speaker: Gromov
dialogues.text: See you... How did Master put this again? Come on, Gromov, think, think...
